src: complete centered 3x3 motif template s with center color, shell color, and symmetric shell offsets
dst: partial motif copy d: either a center pixel alone or a matching shell mask around an empty center
match_cond: d.center_color == s.center_color, or d.shell_color == s.shell_color and d.shell_offsets == s.shell_offsets
transform: paint d's missing shell pixels or missing center pixel to complete the matched motif
